info.title: Smart Stationery Warehouse API
info.description: Admin dashboard backend contract. Runtime data is PostgreSQL; opaque sessions/rate limiting are Redis. This contract is not evidence that every endpoint/migration has passed integration: consult the verification report. Production/main database rollout remains a separately approved operation.

servers.description: Localhost backend. Frontend should use a same-origin /api proxy.

post.description: Issues/rotates an opaque HttpOnly cookie. Response never includes session token/hash. Unknown/inactive/missing or invalid hash gives the same INVALID_CREDENTIALS. Rate limiting is shared in Redis.

post.description: ADMIN/KEEPER: IN+OUT; STAFF: OUT; VIEWER: forbidden. Actor is derived only from the authenticated session. Send exactly five fields; do not send user_id/role/factor/inventory. One UUID per confirmed action; same UUID and payload for all retries. 201 CREATED after confirmed COMMIT; 200 DUPLICATE returns stored snapshot. Database business errors rollback all effects. A lost COMMIT response does not imply rollback; retain UUID on 503 TRANSACTION_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.

get.summary: Get inventory KPIs without mixed-unit grand totals
